about: What the game data (SLK tables) of each Warcraft III patch has, and what changes from one to the next. objects: the ids of UnitData, ItemData, AbilityData, AbilityBuffData (plus buffs only named in an ability's BuffID/EfctID), UpgradeData, DestructableData and Doodads; fields: the ids of each *MetaData.slk (gameInterface is UI/SkinMetaData.slk, the Game Interface table of war3mapSkin.txt); columns: the header row of each SLK. 1.24a to 1.29.2 are the files of the official patch installers, 2.0.4 and 3.0.1 their CASC (2.0.4 without columns). 1.30 to 1.36 are not measured: their changes are inside the 1.29.2 -> 2.0.4 step.
